researched.notes: Source row was the nav text 'ICC Code Solutions Learn More' on nclm.org; the real entity is the merged General Code + American Legal Publishing brand serving 7,000+ communities in 47 states with eCode360 and MapLink. Caveat for owner review: it is the commercial codification arm of the International Code Council, a nonprofit standards body, and part of the deliverable is publishing service rather than software - easy to downgrade if you prefer. HQ and founding year not stated on the site (predecessors were Rochester NY and Cincinnati OH); left null rather than guessed.
